question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **Covardice**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrectly spelled word is "**Covardice**."
 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**Cowardice**."
 
• The error lies in the placement of the "**v**" instead of** 'w**' in the given word. 
 
• **Cowardice **refers to the trait of being excessively afraid or unwilling to confront danger or face difficult situations. (कायरता)
 
 
• **Example**: *Facing the enemy on the battlefield, the soldier displayed an unexpected act of cowardice by abandoning his post.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
